evidence.claim: Microsoft observed GSocket tooling on compromised Linux servers, including renamed relay binaries, cron persistence and connections to GSocket distribution infrastructure.

title: GSocket Distribution Endpoint Connections

1.json:
DeviceNetworkEvents
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1d)
| extend DestinationHost = tolower(iff(RemoteUrl contains "://", tostring(parse_url(RemoteUrl).Host), RemoteUrl))
| where DestinationHost in ("gsocket.io", "gsgg.b-cdn.net")
| project TimeGenerated, DeviceName, InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine, DestinationHost, RemoteIP, ActionType
| order by TimeGenerated desc
| summarize Results = make_list(pack_all())
| project JSON = tostring(Results)
